text_blocks.snippet: An inferior myocardial infarction (MI), or inferior heart attack, is a type of heart attack that occurs when blood flow to the inferior (bottom) wall of the heart is blocked. This blockage typically occurs in either the right coronary artery (RCA) or the left circumflex artery. Inferior MIs are characterized by ST-segment elevation on an electrocardiogram (ECG) in leads II, III, and aVF.
